title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers
summary: This article examines the widespread dissatisfaction, burnout, and loss of faith among tech workers who once believed their careers would be meaningful and impactful. It explores how the promise of tech as a transformative force has collided with reality, leading to an industry-wide crisis of purpose and mental health.
problem_solved: It addresses the growing mental health crisis and existential disillusionment affecting the tech workforce.
why_valuable: The article provides important insight into the human cost of tech industry culture and validates the experiences of thousands of burnt-out tech workers.
